title: Realistic Dream Totem
description: This project replaces the texture of the totem of undying with the dream channel logo
body:
This project replaces the totem of undying texture with a realistic dream texture.

**WARNING:**

This pack may be too realistic, so do download at your own risk. Make sure you know that you are the only one that can see the totem this way.

Have fun!

EnJoYYYYYYYYYYYYY!
